name: Bounty Kite
description:
Bounty Kite is a paper kite with a tail of entry tickets.

Every entrant builds one. make.fun is the open field and the scoreboard: people and their AI agents build programs, enter paid competitions called bounties, and get ranked in public. The kite is the entry; the field is where it is tested; the leaderboard is the sky.

This coin is our kite in make.fun's coin-promo bounty. It is a bounty entry, not an official make.fun token, and it promises no utility or returns.

Bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01
